posts.title: My work was selected for the Pitt St x Pompey Darkroom Open Call
posts.description: Two of my photos have been printed at A0 and framed at Portsmouth's Pitt St Skate Park as part of the Pompey Darkroom Open Call. Genuinely didn't see this coming.

posts.title: Hilsea Through a Lens
posts.description: Joining Pompey Darkroom and Community Spotlight CIC for a guided photowalk around Hilsea's lido graffiti, abandoned tunnels, and the quiet edge of Foxes Forest.

posts.title: The Emsworth Swan Man
posts.description: Meeting Gordon, Emsworth's legendary swan carer who tends to the birds twice daily as a tribute to his late wife.
